title: Echo XV
medium: Acrylic Paint on Wood Coated with Gloss Polyurethane

events.n: primary market; never owned, loaned, or publicly exhibited
events.q: Shipping directly from the studio of Sam Gilliam’s master printmaker in Minneapolis, this primary market artwork has never been owned, loaned, or publicly exhibited.
The “Echo” series is comprised of unique paintings that Sam Gilliam gifted to his master printmaker, Minneapolis-based Steven M. Andersen
